more_beautiful.reason: A is more refined: a punchy two-tone slab headline paired with a clean sans body, a warm cream/rust/manila palette, a well-crafted tilted date tag and a carefully detailed booking form give it clear hierarchy and polish, while B is sparser and heavier (slab type even for body copy, an empty desktop hero, ring bullets that look like radio buttons, slightly off-centre button and radio labels, a bare footer) - though A's visible 'Note for the organisers... edit index.html' box is a real blemish.

less_generic.reason: B builds the whole site around the repair-tag idea (a tag-shaped logo standing in for the missing one, a ticket-style date card with TIME/WHERE fields, manila-on-blue colours, one slab typeface throughout) and skips the stock eyebrow + headline hero, icon-tile card grid and 1-2-3 step cards that make A, with its cream-and-terracotta palette and exposed developer note, read like an AI landing-page template.
